_comment: Production AdMob configuration for Potion Rogue. Debug Android runs use Google's test units through the Admob runtime node; release exports use these real units. Leave a unit id empty to disable that format in release.

unit_ids._app_open_note: App Open unit created in AdMob for release foreground ads.

app_open._note: Shown when the player brings the game back to the foreground, and never on the install session. Menus and the map only, never a battle, story beat or event.
